dependencyRationale: An item action's operation and persisted subject identity pass through the production snapshot, component Store, UI model/router and manager transaction; all four layers must agree to prove exactly-once completion and skip semantics.
fallbackReason: The bounded common and test source sets are required because the exact ScreenAction/ScreenCommand signatures are cross-module public contracts.
